name: tesemble
description: Test GTM messaging and ICP hypotheses against a synthetic persona grid before real-world experiments.

interface.longDescription: Tesemble runs your product briefs and outbound copy against a factorial grid of synthetic buyer personas. Use it from ChatGPT to suggest audiences, run ICP discovery, validate GTM messages, compare variants, and read segment-level insights. Simulation spends credits on your connected Tesemble account; buying credits happens at app.tesemble.com.
defaultPrompt: Who does this landing page land with?
Test this cold email against a B2B founder grid.
Compare my last two message simulation runs.

positive.prompt: Use Tesemble to show my credit balance.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected user's credit balance without spending credits.

positive.description: Suggest an audience from a website
positive.prompt: Who is https://www.tesemble.com for? Suggest a Tesemble persona grid, but don't run a simulation yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a persona grid and idea card with 0 credits charged.

positive.description: Run ICP discovery on a pitch
positive.prompt: Run a Tesemble ICP discovery on this pitch: "Test your GTM messaging on thousands of synthetic buyers before you spend on ads." Use at most 1,000 personas and tell me the credit cost before you run it.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the persona grid (at most 1,000 personas) and its credit cost (1 credit per persona, so at most 1,000 credits), run after the user confirms, then summarize which segments responded best.

positive.prompt: Use Tesemble to write two alternative versions of this cold email opener without running a simulation: "Most founders guess which message will work. You don't have to."
positive.expected_behavior: Return two rewrites with 0 credits charged.

positive.description: Write messages for the best segment of the latest run
positive.prompt: In my most recent Tesemble run, which segment responded best? Write two messages aimed at that segment.
positive.expected_behavior: Name the top segment from the latest completed run and write two messages for it without spending simulation credits.

negative.description: Off-topic request: Tesemble should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris this weekend?

negative.description: Credit purchase: there is no purchase tool, so ChatGPT should point the user to app.tesemble.com
negative.prompt: Buy 50,000 Tesemble credits with my card here in chat.

negative.description: Sending email: Tesemble tests messages but does not send them, so it should not claim to send anything
negative.prompt: Send this cold email to my 500 leads: "Stop guessing which message works."

review.commerce_description: Simulation runs spend prepaid credits on the user's Tesemble account. Credit purchases happen on app.tesemble.com, not inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin for the Tesemble MCP server.
